entries.title: Forecast card snapshot changes
entries.root_cause: The forecast card now omits its unit label after a rendering regression; restore the unit label in the card renderer.

entries.title: French date snapshot uses fallback locale
entries.root_cause: The runner lacks French locale data required by the date formatter, which falls back to English; install the locale data in the CI image.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Another Jest snapshot mismatch, but the date formatting locale falls back rather than the card dropping a unit label.

entries.title: French date snapshot falls back again
entries.root_cause: The runner lacks French locale data required by the date formatter, which falls back to English; install the locale data in the CI image.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run exposes the same missing locale in a different date fixture and a different checkout path.

entries.title: Forecast unit still absent
entries.root_cause: The forecast card now omits its unit label after a rendering regression; restore the unit label in the card renderer.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run renders another temperature fixture after unrelated tests and reports a shifted source line.
